chunks: Al-Sadiq عليه السلام was asked about the saying of Allah, Mighty and Majestic:
He said: "The purified spouses are those who do not menstruate and do not experience postnatal bleeding."

key_terms.أَزْوَاجٌ مُطَهَّرَةٌ: purified spouses, free from bodily impurity
key_terms.قَوْلِ اللَّهِ: the statement of Allah in the Quran
key_terms.لَا يُحْدِثْنَ: they do not experience postnatal bleeding

ai.seo_question: What does the Quran mean by purified spouses in Paradise?
ai.summary: This report explains the Quranic phrase about purified spouses in Paradise as referring to freedom from bodily states such as menstruation and postnatal bleeding. It highlights the complete purity and perfection of the blessings of the people of Paradise.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.195 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) was asked about the saying of Allah (swt), the Exalted:
'They will have therein purified spouses.' [Surah Al-Baqarah 2:25]
Imam (as) said: 'The purified spouses are those who do not menstruate and do not experience postnatal bleeding.'
